author: minmaxxxer
description:
Premier League 2026-27 closing odds and graded results
	

All 100 matches played so far in the 2026-27 Premier League season (updated every Monday; last update 9 November 2026) with the betting market's consensus opening and closing odds —
1X2, over/under 2.5 goals, both teams to score and the Asian handicap main line — and every market already graded.
One row per match, ready for pandas, R, SQL or a spreadsheet.
Built for backtesting, closing line value (CLV) research, model… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/minmaxxxer/premier-league-odds-2026-27.
